headline: Gold Prices Waver as Strong US Inflation Data Fuels Rate Hike Expectations
summary: Spot gold hovered around $3,580 an ounce following a volatile session as robust US inflation data fueled expectations of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
why: Gold is traditionally viewed as an inflation hedge, but higher interest rates increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion, often triggering price corrections.

impacts.name: Spot gold
impacts.why: Stronger inflation prints and hawkish rate bets directly alter precious metals pricing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hotter US inflation readings strengthened expectations for further monetary tightening, boosting yields and weighing on non-yielding precious metals.
